module.name: kind_cluster_label_dpu_nodes
module.description: Label two kind worker nodes app=f5-tmm and taint them dpu=true:NoSchedule so FLO/TMM scheduling matches the f5-bnk-udf lab pattern. Required for FLO to schedule TMM pods on a kind cluster.

required.name: kubeconfig
required.description: Base64-encoded kubeconfig for the kind cluster. Wired by the blueprint from kind-cluster-create / kind-cluster-register.

optional.name: dpu_node_names
optional.description: Worker nodes to label as DPU-equivalent.

optional.name: tmm_label_key
optional.description: Label key applied to DPU nodes.

optional.name: tmm_label_value
optional.description: Label value applied to DPU nodes.

optional.name: dpu_taint_key
optional.description: Taint key applied to DPU nodes.

optional.name: dpu_taint_value
optional.description: Taint value applied to DPU nodes.

optional.name: dpu_taint_effect
optional.description: Taint effect applied to DPU nodes.

key_outputs.name: labeled_nodes
key_outputs.description: Node names that received the TMM label and DPU taint.
